name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Lvars_range
typeText:
∀ (L : Nat),
  LE.le.{0} L 9 →
    ∀ (x : Nat),
      Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Lvars L) x →
        And (LE.le.{0} 40 x) (LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN)

source.code:
theorem Lvars_range (L : ℕ) (hL : L ≤ 9) : ∀ x, x ∈ Lvars L → 40 ≤ x ∧ x < IN := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [Lvars, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hx
  rcases hx with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> constructor <;> addr'
